subject: science
concept: Designing and conducting a quantitative investigation involving motion, momentum, or circuits
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student designs and runs a quantitative investigation (timing motion, measuring circuit values) and records data
exercise.pictorial: Student graphs their investigation's collected data
exercise.abstract: Student compares their investigation's measured results to a theoretical prediction and explains any difference

assessment.mastery_threshold: comparison and explanation are grounded in the investigation's actual recorded data
misconception_flags: dismisses a real measured discrepancy without offering any scientifically plausible explanation

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
